description: WWCP Core defines entities and reference virtual components for the World Wide Charging Protocol Suite. Its README describes EV supply equipment, stations, charging pools, operators, roaming providers and national access points as interoperating objects. It also links adapters for OICP, OCPI and OCPP so implementations can exchange charging and roaming messages. Users integrate the C# library into a charging-network service or test environment; outputs are typed protocol structures and simulated components, not a public transaction dataset. Geographic coverage follows the operators and protocols implemented by adopters. GitHub metadata states AGPL-3.0 licensing. A limitation is that protocol compatibility does not establish real charger uptime, energy capacity, metering accuracy or live operator participation. WWCP Core can support interoperability tests and agent-based EV infrastructure scenarios. The related AequilibraE catalogue model addresses road traffic, not charging-station protocols. No charging feeds or compiled library were downloaded.
